name: doit-mcp
description: DoiT Cloud Intelligence for Claude: tools and skills for cloud cost analysis, reporting, anomalies, budgets and alerts, plus an optional Claude Code channel that tells an open session about new cost anomalies and cloud incidents.

api_key.title: DoiT API key (channel only)
api_key.description: Optional. Needed only to receive channel events in Claude Code. A personal API token from the DoiT console (Profile > API tokens). The tools sign in through your browser and do not use it.

events.title: Channel events
events.description: Comma-separated event kinds to push into the session: anomalies, incidents.

poll_seconds.title: Channel poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to check for new events. Minimum 60.
